title: 4.2.0-stored secrets through the RC validators
notes: Each vector is a secret exactly as 4.2.0 (or 3.7.x for V2 chain accounts) stored it, built with the production 7508bc83 crypto and the 4.2.0 schema DSL, together with the durable public identity 4.2.0 recorded. The RC validator must accept every one (signing keeps working; safety invariant 4).

Sources: 4.2.0 AccountRepositoryDelegate.create (mnemonic), AccountRepositoryImpl.importNewAccount (raw seed), importFromJson (JSON), TonAccountRepository.create (TON, raw typed text stored), 3.7.4 importChainFromMnemonic/importChainFromSeed (V2 chain accounts).
